# Likely causes

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-docs.ts from src/diagnose/index.ts. Do not edit. -->

Every finding gets the most likely cause, with a confidence score. The
diagnosis combines the shape of the two values (timestamps, number formats,
random tokens, generated class names), the source code around the element
(`Date.now()`, `localStorage`, `matchMedia`, ...), the scenario (locale,
timezone, color scheme, viewport) and the stage where the difference started.

## time

**Time-dependent value**

- The server and the browser render at different moments. Pass the timestamp the server used as a prop, or render the time after mount (useEffect).

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/time

## timezone

**Timezone difference**

- The server and the browser format dates in different timezones. Pass an explicit timeZone to the formatter (the same on both sides), or format the date after mount.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/timezone

## locale

**Locale-dependent formatting**

- toLocaleString / Intl formatters use the server locale on the server and the browser locale on the client. Pass an explicit locale (for example from the URL or a cookie) on both sides.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/locale

## random

**Random value**

- Random values differ on every render. Generate them once on the server and pass them down, or use useId for element ids.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/random

## browser-api

**Browser-only API used during render**

- Code like `typeof window !== "undefined"` or window/navigator/document access renders differently on the server. Read browser values in useEffect, or render the component on the client only.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/browser-api

## storage

**localStorage / sessionStorage read during render**

- Storage is only available in the browser. Render a neutral value first and read storage in useEffect.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/storage

## media-query

**Screen size or media query read during render**

- Use CSS media queries for layout differences, or read matchMedia / window size after mount.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/media-query

## theme

**Theme preference (dark/light mode)**

- The server cannot know the color scheme. Store the theme in a cookie and read it on the server, or set the class with an inline script before hydration and mark that element with suppressHydrationWarning.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/theme

## data

**Server and client used different data**

- The client fetched data again and got a different result. Send the data the server rendered with to the client (props, the framework data APIs, or a serialized cache) instead of refetching during hydration.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/data

## invalid-html

**Invalid HTML nesting**

- Fix the nesting so the browser does not rewrite it, for example use <span> instead of <div> inside <p>.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/invalid-html

## css-in-js

**CSS-in-JS class names differ**

- Enable the library's server rendering support (for styled-components: `compiler.styledComponents` in next.config and a style registry) and never create styled components conditionally.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/css-in-js

## extension

**Browser extension**

- A browser extension changed the page. Nothing to fix in your code; ignore these attributes or test in a clean profile.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/extension

## third-party-script

**A script changed the page before hydration**

- Load the script after hydration (for example next/script with strategy="afterInteractive" or "lazyOnload"), or make it change only elements outside React's tree.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/third-party-script

## cdn

**HTML rewritten by a CDN or proxy**

- Turn off HTML minification or rewriting (e.g. Cloudflare Auto Minify, email obfuscation) for server-rendered pages.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/cdn

## unstable-id

**Generated id differs**

- Use React's useId instead of counters or random ids, and use the same identifierPrefix on server and client.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/unstable-id

## form-state

**Server Action form state**

- The server rendered this form with the result of a submitted Server Action (useActionState with a permalink), but the client hydrated without that state. Let the framework pass the form state to hydrateRoot (Next.js does this), and render the form from the action state only.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/form-state

## suppressed

**Intentional difference (suppressHydrationWarning)**

- Keep suppressHydrationWarning on the smallest element that needs it.

Online: https://hydration.jscrate.dev/docs/causes/suppressed
